fix_code:
def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    white, black = map(int, input().split())
    
    s = "wbwbwwbwbwbw"
    S = list(s)
    n = len(S)
    
    for start in range(n):
        if start + white + black > n:
            break
        substring = S[start:start + white + black]
        w_count = substring.count('w')
        b_count = substring.count('b')
        
        if w_count == white and b_count == black:
            print("Yes")
            return
    
    print("No")
